title: Reference-video analysis and frame-comparison design
capabilities: Design inspiration: timed observations, absolute corrections, reference-render frame pairs and distilled authoring notes.
Native workbench implemented independently; no upstream code or assets copied.
limits: This record tracks external design research; it does not claim an imported HyperFrames runtime or activate trusted instructions.
Source and license inspection are documented in reference/motion-sources.md; upstream NOTICE was absent at root in this revision.
No upstream assets are needed. Third-party GSAP, fonts and unconfirmed textures are excluded.
Local comparison tools do not infer original layers, automatically reconstruct arbitrary video, score quality or verify spoken content.
useWhen: Study a user-selected reference and compare an authored native editor export at declared timestamps.
avoidWhen: Recovering the original project or claiming that arbitrary-video recreation or private AI backends are open source.
